notes: Modified cash basis village audit, FY ended 9/30/2022, aligned with FY2023. Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total column (pp7-10; fund columns General, Road, Lottery, Ambulance, Garbage, Fire Hall, Police, Library, Adjustment). Garbage Fund is reported by the village as a governmental fund (Sanitation). transfers_in/transfers_out are the Total column's printed figures (in 0, out 696 after the Adjustments column eliminates 86,728; p10); detail other-financing lines stay per fund. Fund balance 579,532 -> 797,317 (ties). ending_cash = governmental funds Total Cash and Cash Equivalents 792,411 (p6); Cash at County Treasurer 4,906 is a separate line; no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash is null. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement Totals (p12); business-type disbursements 822,494 = Total Operating Expenses 818,793 + Interest Expense 3,701, printed as one figure on the Statement of Activities (p3). Net position 1,240,198 + 1,148,613 - 822,494 + transfers 696 = 1,567,013. Grants: budget schedule Federal Receipts 307,754 (p14) = General 38,937 + Library 3,871 + Electric Grant Income 264,946, so those are federal; Ambulance 750 stays other/Grants. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1). Proprietary statement of cash flows (p13) not recorded (proprietary null, as in later years). Detail: revenue by fund from the governmental funds statement columns, expenditures by object and fund from the Schedule of Expenditures (pp16-17; Grants Fund all zero), utility funds from the proprietary statement columns; zero cells skipped. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Total Primary Government (pp14-15, combined all funds) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-17 of 17
